comments.body:
First contribution to Nix/Nixos, hope everything follows the conventions and it is at least decent quality. Couple of notes:

- building the man pages requires two pip packages that are not in nixpkgs, and they are currently built in a let expression surrounding the derivation. The proper way to do it is probably to package these two dependencies properly, but I'm unsure if I should open other PRs for them or do it here.
- I'm not sure what to put in the "maintainer" field, i.e. if I should add myself to one of the maintainer groups or someone should "adopt" the package.

Feedback is appreciated :+1:

Unfortunately, this [package](https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/tree/master/pkgs/os-specific/linux/autosuspend) has been already merged into nixpkgs.

I see you created a module for it, if you want, we can try to merge your module.

reviews.body:
Hi there! Welcome, and thanks for choosing to contribute to the project.

> First contribution to Nix/Nixos

Woo! 🚀 

> The proper way to do it is probably to package these two dependencies properly, but I'm unsure if I should open other PRs for them or do it here.

> Here seems reasonable.

If you're willing to become a maintainer that is awesome. You can add yourself to the maintainer list. Please do that in a separate commit and have that commit come first.

I don't generally review packages, just modules, but don't worry... someone will be along shortly to review the packages I'm sure.

I have left a few comments for discussion. Don't hesitate to ask for any advice/help/etc...

To comply with [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/blob/master/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md#submitting-changes) please have the commit message name be of the format
```
<pkg-name>: <subject-line>
```
for more examples, please look at https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/blob/master/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md#submitting-changes

in your case, you should have a commit per package and module added.
